userMessage: Some research has linked multivitamin/mineral use with faster progression of age-related macular degeneration (AMD). If you have AMD or a related eye condition, please check with an eye specialist before starting a multivitamin.

review.note: Severity confirmed as moderate (not high) by reviewer 2026-09-05 - consistent with this being a progression-risk association from one review rather than an acute contraindication, and with multivitamins already being sold over-the-counter in e-commerce without prescription. Source: https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S1568163725003113
